description: This PHP source file defines a class 'LeaveAllocateEmailProcessor' used for processing email notifications related to leave allocations within the OrangeHRM system. The class includes methods for generating email content replacements and determining recipients based on leave allocation events.

classes.name: LeaveAllocateEmailProcessor
classes.description: A class responsible for handling email processing related to leave allocations, including generating email content replacements and managing recipient selection based on leave allocation events.

methods.name: getReplacements
methods.description: Generates an array of placeholder replacements for an email, based on the leave allocation event, recipient, and performer details.

methods.name: getRecipients
methods.description: Determines the list of email recipients based on the specified recipient role and leave allocation event.
